237:t_009:16.en:
$n
「I...! I refuse to submit to those things!!」

237:t_010:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「...All units, follow me. Cast off the fear within you. We're going to strike them down.」

237:t_010:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now I understand... The nightmares I saw when I became a $$特異点$$...」

237:t_010:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「The thing I saw destroying humanity... The fundamental calamity humanity must face, you might say... It isn't $$バアル$$...!」

237:t_010:6.en:
$n
「That's why we... have to fight them...!」

237:t_010:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「I can tell... They're trying to eliminate us...!」

237:t_010:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Their power is dark, cold... and overwhelming...」

237:t_010:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Could they be the ones who transported us here, too...?!」

237:t_010:10.en:
$$レド$$
「We have to fight...! To survive!!」

237:t_010:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah...! No matter what we're up against!」

237:t_010:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin attacking $$サイデリアル$$!」

237:t_010:13.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Do not falter! The enemy is trying to break our will to fight!」

237:t_010:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「You enemies standing in the way of humanity's future...! You fundamental calamity!」

237:t_010:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll overcome you! Right here, right now!!」

237:t_014:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
(I'm sorry, Mom, $$チェーミン$$...)

237:t_014:5.en:

($$オードリー$$... Is this goodbye...?)

237:t_014:7.en:

237:t_014:8.en:

237:t_016:5.en:
???

237:t_016:6.en:

237:t_017:1.en:
$$ブライト$$

237:t_018:0.en:

237:t_019:0.en:

237:t_019:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Recall our escorts! Don't let those monsters do as they please!」

237:t_020:0.en:

「The right engine has been hit! Power is dropping!」

237:t_020:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ラッセ$$! Is our navigation affected?!」

237:t_020:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「We'll lose some speed, but I'll keep us going! I'm not dying in a place like this!」

237:t_020:3.en:

「$$フェルト$$, request help from our units! $$ミレイナ$$, order $$イアン$$ to make emergency repairs!」
